environment.training: E:/anaconda3/envs/pytorch (Python 3.11.16, torch 2.11.0+cu128, sklearn 1.9.0, shap 0.51.0; CUDA verified on RTX 5070)

band: core (9-15 GHz, 601 points); wideband not used in primary experiments

splits.test_policy: No test labels read before configuration freeze

inputs.frequency: query coordinate, never actionable, never explained

PRNet_primary.rational_form: S_c(f) = d_c + sum_k [r_ck/(s-p_k) + conj(r_ck)/(s-conj(p_k))], s = j*2*pi*f, f in GHz, c in {S21, S11}
PRNet_primary.pole_sharing: poles shared by S21 and S11; residues complex per channel; d_c real
PRNet_primary.pole_parameterization: natural frequency f_k = f_min + cumsum(softplus(u)) (ordered); Q_k = Q_min + softplus(v), Q_min = 0.5; p_k = 2*pi*f_k*(-1/(2Q_k) + j*sqrt(1-1/(4Q_k^2))); stable by construction
PRNet_primary.initialization: train-only vector-fitting pole medians (N=10), results/step0/vf_summary.json prnet_init_train; f_min = 8 GHz
PRNet_primary.pole_supervision: none; poles learned end-to-end so vector-fitting poles remain independent ground truth
PRNet_primary.loss: complex MSE + lambda * region-averaged standardized Huber on S21_dB + mu * region-averaged (|S21|^2+|S11|^2-1)^2 (lossless penalty, mu = 10, adopted 2026-10-25; early stopping on the loss without the penalty)
PRNet_primary.K6_sensitivity: only if PR-Net fails the gate with errors concentrated in multiband designs
PRNet_primary.evidence: scripts/vf_order_check.py, 30 train designs: N=10 S21 dB MAE median 0.007, S11 passband MAE median 0.007 (worst 0.036); 3 in-band poles (11.3-12.7 GHz, Q 12-39) + 2 out-of-band low-Q poles (~6.8 and ~15.2 GHz)

from_paper: BatchNorm + LeakyReLU(0.1) after each hidden layer
learning rate reduced on validation plateau
M0_paper_reproduction.dB_clipping: none (train min S21 -59.4 dB, S11 -103.5 dB)

M1_black_box_control.derived: S21_dB and S11_dB = 20*log10(|S|) with -300 dB floor
M1_black_box_control.loss: complex MSE + lambda * region-averaged standardized Huber on S21_dB
M1_black_box_control.frequency_encoding: u=(f-9e9)/6e9; [u, sin(2*pi*k*u), cos(2*pi*k*u)]; k=0 means raw u only (former M3 folded in)

B1_PCA_GPR.PCA_target: concatenated Re/Im of S21 and S11, train only

B2_XGBoost_optional.targets: scalar explanation targets T0, T1b, T2
B2_XGBoost_optional.explainer: TreeSHAP (interventional, same reference/background as surrogate SHAP)
B2_XGBoost_optional.when: after configuration freeze, if time allows
B2_XGBoost_optional.note: xgboost not installed in env yet

post_freeze_extras: primary model retrained with geometry_only preset
primary model retrained with control replicates 1 and 2

batch.PRNet_and_M0: 16 or 64 whole designs, selected on validation

training.lr_schedule: ReduceLROnPlateau factor 0.5 patience 10 on validation loss, all three networks
training.deviation_from_original: original 300 epochs / patience 30 / scheduler only for M0; changed in step 1 because PR-Net oscillated at fixed lr and no model had converged (2026-10-25)
training.physics: PR-Net: lossless soft penalty mu = 10 (step1b_passivity, user adopted 2026-10-25); M1, M0, B1: |S11|^2+|S21|^2-1 reported as diagnostic only

selection.primary_model_rule: PR-Net is primary by design if it passes the gate (not replaced even if M1 is slightly more accurate); if PR-Net fails and M1 passes, M1 takes over RQ3 and PR-Net keeps concept-level analysis with caveats

explanation_targets.T1b_paper_target: mean S21_dB over fixed passband 11.6-12.4 GHz
explanation_targets.T3_concepts_PRNet_only: natural frequency and Q of the 3 in-band poles

paper_protocol.use: comparison with Suslova et al. and testing their consistency criterion

negative-control attribution share vs measured model intervention sensitivity

GradientExplainer (100 backgrounds) deviation from exact 512-coalition SHAP

notes: background poles 1 and 5 not identifiable in 9-15 GHz
PR-Net max power-balance deviation 0.148; soft penalty tested in step1b_passivity

step1b_passivity.penalty: mu * region-weighted mean of (P-1)^2 (lossless) or relu(P-1)^2 (passive), P = |S21|^2+|S11|^2; training loss only, early stopping on rf_loss

implementation.explained_validation: all 5 single-band mask passes + 35 failing single-band designs by source (largest remainder), seed 2026; baseline as row 41
implementation.own_LIME: truncated Gaussian, std 0.25 train-std units, within declared bounds, 1000 fit + 500 held out, kernel width 0.75*sqrt(9)*std; scales 0.1/0.5 and 5 seeds for stability; LIME-delta = slope*(x-ref)
implementation.paper_LIME: lime package defaults (quartile discretization, 5000 samples), random_state 0-19
implementation.deletion_insertion: read from the 512-coalition table; order by phi*sign(F(x)-F(ref))
implementation.concept_level: PR-Net concept-group Shapley over 8 groups (f2,f3,f4,Q2,Q3,Q4,residues,background), baseline-design concepts fill absent groups
implementation.B_concept_truth: vector fitting (N=10) of the 13 ADS baseline diagnostic curves

findings: exact SHAP additivity <= 2e-4; SHAP deletion/insertion in top 5% of random orders for 70-100% of cases
IG fails on S11_dB at 12.0 GHz (45-57% of designs residual > 1% after 256 steps; path crosses reflection zeros); SHAP unaffected
M0 uses the negative controls (intervention share 4-8%) and explainers report 3-11%; PR-Net and M1 <= 1% both
attribution differences come from the reference/background choice (0.70-0.86) more than explainer (0.93-0.99) or seed (0.95-0.99) for PR-Net/M1; M0 seed stability 0.75-0.85
GradientExplainer vs exact SHAP on the same 100 backgrounds: rank 0.92-0.98 (M0 0.80-0.86), values ~20% off on T1-T2
paper protocol SHAP-LIME rho on T1b: PR-Net 0.86 (paper 0.86), M1 0.87, M0 0.75
ADS +-5% one-factor diagnostics: PR-Net/M1 model finite differences sign 0.99-1.00, rank 0.98-0.99; M0 0.86/0.64; local gradients/LIME sign ~0.9 but rank 0.5-0.6
PR-Net concept finite differences vs ADS vector fitting: sign 0.98, rank 0.99
T0: all models and explainers give L2 > L1 > Wc2
PR-Net concept-group Shapley: ~75% of T2 attribution from the three resonator frequencies, Q ~15-20%
